T:P1.3.text: Pangaea is a global provider of comprehensive maritime logistics and transportation solutions. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its clients by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities. We not only own and operate a large fleet of bulk carriers, including high ice class vessels but we design, produce and operate port and inland projects.

T:P1.5.text: No two projects are the same. We customize each project based on our client's specific needs. Our attention to detail is critical in forming lasting relationships. If you have a need, we will find a solution.

T:P1.6.text: Almost 50% of our owned fleet is made up of Ice Class 1A vessels. We have pioneered both the Northern Sea Route and the Northwest Passage resulting in lower CO2 emissions, fewer days at sea and substantial fuel savings.

T:P1.8.text: We have expertise in the development and expansion of port facilities; specifically loading and discharging operations. We recently completed a loading port in Newfoundland and the expansion of a port terminal in Charleston, S.C.

T:P1.10.text: We have extensive experience in handling cargoes like DRI A, B & C. We educate and train our crew to avoid any issues while carrying these complex cargoes. SAFETY is always our #1 priority.

T:P2.3.text: Pangaea is a US-based maritime logistics and transportation company utilizing its expertise to service a broad base of customers who require the transportation of a wide variety of dry bulk cargoes. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its customers by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities that seeks to add value at every step of the supply chain.

T:P2.4.text: The Company operates a fleet of approximately 45-60 Supramax, Panamax and Handymax vessels, of which 40 are owned or partially owned. The Company is a leader in the high ice class sector, secured by its control of a majority of the world’s large dry bulk vessels with Ice-Class 1a designation.

C:P1.2.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

C:P1.3.text: Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

C:P1.4.text: Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

C:P1.5.text: It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail shippers moving forward.

C:P1.6.text: TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.

C:P1.7.text: years in business 50+ years manufacturing railcars, 40+ years leasing railcars

C:P1.8.text: major commercial end markets serving 21 different commodity markets with the broadest railcar product offering in North America

C:P1.11.text: As a leading railcar lessor enabled by rail transportation manufacturing and services in North America, Trinity Industries is committed to supporting a more sustainable future and making meaningful contributions to address our long-term impact.

C:P1.12.text: We are dedicated to integrating sustainability principles, including socially responsible and environmentally conscious corporate practices, grounded in a robust governance framework to ensure we continue operating at the industry's highest standards.

C:P2.1.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - About Us

C:P2.2.text: Trinity began providing industrial products and services to customers more than 85 years ago. We started as a small butane-tank manufacturer and evolved over time into a premier provider of railcar products and services in North America with a leading railcar lease fleet and manufacturing, maintenance and repair operations.

C:P2.3.text: Our rail-related products and services are marketed under the trade name TrinityRail. Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

C:P2.4.text: The TrinityRail platform plays an important role in the North American supply chain by facilitating the transportation of bulk commodities and goods by rail. Railcar transportation is sustainable and is the most economical land-based mode of transportation. At Trinity, we strive to employ company resources in ways that make positive contributions to our stakeholders for the benefit of current and future generations.
